body.faq_description: Common questions about SEO services, timelines, technical work and how we measure growth.

faqs.question: What SEO services does IGENTX provide?
faqs.answer: We provide technical SEO audits, on-page optimisation, content strategy, local and international SEO, schema markup and monthly performance reporting. Engagements are scoped to your site size, markets and competition.

faqs.question: How long does SEO take to show results?
faqs.answer: Technical SEO improvements can show indexing and speed gains within weeks. Meaningful ranking improvements for competitive keywords typically take 3-6 months with consistent content and authority building. Local SEO for location-specific queries may show faster results. We set realistic expectations and track progress monthly.

faqs.question: Do you provide technical SEO audits?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our audits cover crawlability, indexing, site speed, Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, structured data, internal linking and security issues. You receive a prioritised action plan with quick wins and longer-term improvements.

faqs.question: Do you provide local SEO?
faqs.answer: Yes. We optimise Google Business Profile, local citations, multilingual landing pages and location-specific schema markup. Local search benefits from mobile-first performance, relevant content and strong technical foundations.

faqs.question: What is the difference between on-page and technical SEO?
faqs.answer: On-page SEO focuses on content and HTML elements visible to users and search engines: titles, headings, copy and internal links. Technical SEO focuses on how search engines crawl and index your site: speed, architecture, redirects, schema and mobile experience. Both are needed for sustainable growth.

faqs.question: Do you work with existing websites or only new builds?
faqs.answer: Both. We optimise existing WordPress, Shopify and custom sites, and we build SEO-first architectures on new Next.js projects. For redesigns we plan URL migrations and redirects to preserve search equity where possible.

faqs.question: How do you measure SEO success?
faqs.answer: We track organic traffic, keyword rankings, click-through rates, conversions and technical health metrics. Success means qualified visitors and business outcomes, not vanity rankings alone. Monthly reports show progress and next priorities.

faqs.question: Do you provide ongoing SEO support?
faqs.answer: Yes. SEO is ongoing work. We offer monthly retainers covering content updates, technical monitoring, link-building guidance and performance reviews. Support is tailored to your competition level and growth goals.

faqs.question: Do you provide SEO services in the UAE?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer dedicated SEO for UAE businesses including Google Maps local SEO, multilingual strategy and technical audits. See our UAE SEO services page for regional engagements.
